# Draft:Madeline McQueen (actress)

----
Madeline McQueen from Bexley is an English actress who has worked in film, television, video games, commercials, theatre, and immersive theatre. She is, among other roles, the mother in Fractured Island (2025). She voiced one of the leading characters, Zoe, in an award-winning murder mystery game, Cold Case inc. (2023). Madeline has made appearances in adverts such as for Kent Police (2020).
Career
Film and television
In Film, Madeline appeared alongside Dave Courtney and Craig Charles in a zombie horror film, Clubbing to Death (2008). She was also in the Act/Or film (2015) with Johnathan Hyde.
In television, Madeline was a part of the Millennium Dome New Year’s Eve opening ceremony, the official opening by Queen Elizabeth II, in 1999 in one of the school choirs. Madeline has also been seen in the news as Mrs Claus, who was a part of Father Christmas' grotto, in a popular Christmas event, the Dickens Rochester Christmas festival in 2024. Madeline also voiced as the guest-star, Rita, in an award-winning adult animated television series, called Dr. Apple's Lazy Loung (2026).
Voice Over
Apart from voicing in Dr Apple's Lazy Lounge, Madeline has dubbed in a short romance film titled INTO YOU (2025), where she was the English voice for the main actress. She has voiced in many games, adverts, animations, audi dramas and narrated for e-leanring apps and audio books.
Author
Madeline first started writting books with her first novel that she republished in 2017, titled [https://www.amazon.co.uk/Anuanna-Karda-Jewel-Part-1/dp/167318300X/ref=tmm%20pap%20swatch%200 Anuanna: The Karda Jewel] parts 1 and 2. She then wrote the next book to the series - [https://www.amazon.co.uk/Anuanna-Forbidden-Curse-Madeline-McQueen-ebook/dp/B0F7GMC4MN?ref%20=ast%20author%20dp Anuanna: The Forbidden Curse] in 2025.
In 2020, Madeline also wrote a short paranormal memoir called [http://The%20Real%20Haunted%20Stories%20of%20a%20Girl:%2013%20short%20ghostly%20stories The Real Haunted Stories of a Girl: 13 short ghostly stories]. Which is about her spooky expereinces.
Madeline has also written a children's book called [https://www.amazon.co.uk/Journey-Friendly-Ghost-Robbie-Lonely/dp/B0F8VRLS49/ref=tmm%20pap%20swatch%200 Jouney of a friendly ghost: Robbie the friendly ghost]. About a lonely ghost boy who ends up finding his best friend after everyone else runs away in fear, published in 2025.
Screen Writer, Director and Producer
The first film Madeline wrote was in 2009 with her feature film called "The Hitchiker's Project" about a pair of friends doing a university project that didn't go to plan.
In 2014, she write and produced her second film which was a short horror called Don't Move In.
Madeline has written more film scripts that haven't been produced but have won awards in film festivals.
Awards and Nominations
Madeline has won or made it to the finals in top teir and respected film festivals such as Raindance and Accolade Global Film Competition, among others, for her TV Series - Eyes and Ears of the Dead and films - Scarier Movie and Don't Move In.
